ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills white to creamy-white, crowded, with numerous shorter lamellulae

🌲🌳 Mycorrhizal with hardwoods and conifers (birch, pine and spruce); alone, scattered or gregariously; sandy or peaty soils; summer to autumn

🏥 Used as microdosing nootrop and as folk medicine

🔤 Iconic red woodland Amanita with white veil warts, pendulous ring and concentric volval rings around a bulbous base
